generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. Every piece of work you produce can be examined, weighed against a standard and used to do better next time. The students who treat reflection that way are the ones whose work improves from one task to the next, rather than repeating the same mistakes. Treat what follows as being about your own practice, not about reflection in the abstract.

The same discipline runs through professional life. Appraisal, supervision and continuing professional development all rest on it, in every field: examining your own practice honestly, weighing it against a standard, and acting on what you find. The habit you build here is one you keep long after you graduate.
